tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Index Numbers Population Estimation

questions.question: Q: In the base year 2020, a basket of goods cost £200. In 2024 the same basket costs £260. Calculate the index number for 2024 with 2020 as the base.
questions.correctAnswer: Index = (260 ÷ 200) × 100 = 130. Prices have risen by 30% since the base year.
questions.explanation: Answer: Index = (260 ÷ 200) × 100 = 130. Prices have risen by 30% since the base year.

questions.question: Q: In a capture-recapture study, 48 rabbits are caught, tagged and released. Later, 60 rabbits are caught and 12 have tags. Estimate the total rabbit population.
questions.correctAnswer: N = (48 × 60) ÷ 12 = 2880 ÷ 12 = 240. The estimated population is 240 rabbits.
questions.explanation: Answer: N = (48 × 60) ÷ 12 = 2880 ÷ 12 = 240. The estimated population is 240 rabbits.
